issues.on_page: Personal Services 30,279.37 (Pool and Park Fund column only)
issues.issue: Business-type spending is printed by cost type; under the utility cost-type rule (user 2026-10-28) this line would be Salaries and Wages, while Supplies/Repairs/Professional lines of the same statement were given cost-type categories. Same question for disbursements[21] 'Operating Disbursements' 8,159.80 (Operating/utilities vs culture/recreation) and detail[58..63] Pool and Park lines. Pool and Park is not a utility, so culture/recreation is defensible; inconsistent within the report.

Interest lines carry category Interest Income but detail_category 'investment income' (also detail[19], detail[21]); other reports use detail_category Interest Income for interest lines. Likewise detail[3] Property Tax Credit and detail[6] Homestead Exemption use detail_category 'homestead/tax credits' although the user rule gives these own detail_category values.
